snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3 - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection now.
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/products/

Watch the launch trailer for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - the next evolution of the turn-based, story-rich RPG series set in the world of Monster Hunter. Befriend, raise, and battle with iconic monsters in this vibrant, memorable, and expansive RPG adventure.

Your story begins March 13, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC/Steam.
  
Download the free demo and carry your save data over to the full game.
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/trial/
